title: Adding a repository/connection type or job action requires edits across apps/provisioning AND pkg/registry/apis/provisioning
answers: What do I need to change to add a new repository backend type?
What breaks if I only implement repository.Extra and don't register it?
How do I add a new JobAction?
body:
Adding a new repository or connection backend type requires ALL of: (1) a new `RepositoryType`/`ConnectionType` constant in apps/provisioning/pkg/apis/provisioning/v0alpha1/types.go, (2) an implementation of `repository.Extra` or `connection.Extra` (apps/provisioning/pkg/repository/factory.go:Extra / apps/provisioning/pkg/connection/factory.go:Extra) providing Type/Build/Mutate/Validate, (3) registration of that Extra in `pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/extras/register.go:ProvideProvisioningOSSRepositoryExtras`, and (4) admission wiring already dispatches generically via the Factory, but any new admission constant (e.g. AllowedTargets) must also be updated in pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/register.go. Skipping (3) means the type builds but is never constructible/validatable at runtime (silent no-op, not a compile error).

Similarly, adding a new `JobAction` requires a case in `jobs.ValidateJob` (apps/provisioning/pkg/jobs/validator.go) AND a corresponding worker in pkg/registry/apis/provisioning/jobs/ (a different Go module/package) — these are updated independently and easy to leave inconsistent (validator accepts an action with no worker, or vice versa).

Separately: editing apps/provisioning/kinds/*.cue requires running `make generate` (apps/provisioning/Makefile, delegates to the grafana-app-sdk generator) to regenerate pkg/generated/** and zz_generated.* — hand-editing types.go without regenerating leaves OpenAPI/deepcopy/client code stale. Mock files (`*_mock.go`) are mockery-generated from `//go:generate mockery` directives above each interface (e.g. apps/provisioning/pkg/repository/repository.go:Repository) — don't hand-edit them, regenerate instead.
applies: Applies when extending apps/provisioning/pkg (new repo/connection backend, new job action, or changed CUE kind). Does not apply to unrelated bugfixes within an existing backend's Extra implementation.
